body.statement: Under i.i.d. sampling, finite second moments, full assignment support, and Fieller nondegeneracy, \(P\bigl((\mu_t^\star)_{t\in\mathcal B}\in\prod_{t\in\mathcal B}\mathcal F_t\bigr)\ge1-\alpha_0+o(1)\). Hence \(H(\prod_{t\in\mathcal B}\mathcal F_t)\) covers \(\boldsymbol\theta\) with probability at least \(1-\alpha_0+o(1)\); the set may be unbounded or disconnected.
body.justification: Test inversion remains informative about identification weakness because it is allowed to return unbounded sets.
body.gap: Existing factorial-IV work treats scalar Fieller intervals; the contribution here is the explicit Bonferroni product and Walsh image for the dependent eight-ratio system, not uniform weak-share adaptation.
body.consumer: Applied analysts obtain a simultaneous fallback when the estimated perfect-complier share is too small for the Wald ellipsoid.
